description.en: How a steppe confederation reached from China to Hungary in half a century, split into khanates, and how Horde rule over Rus' ended on the Ugra.
From Zheng He's fleets to Dezhnev's strait: how in two centuries sailors linked every continent, and what it meant for the Americas.
Twelve centuries in a few minutes: from the legendary founding of Rome through the Republic, the Punic Wars and Caesar to the Empire and its fall in the West.
Fifteen centuries of roads between China and the Mediterranean: envoys and monks, silk and paper, Marco Polo and the plague — and how sea routes took over from the caravans.

title.en: Rus': from Rurik to Ivan III

description.en: Six centuries of Russian history: the Varangians, Kiev and Christianisation, the break-up into principalities, Horde rule, the rise of Moscow and Ivan III's united state.
From the Nazi rise to power to Hiroshima: the key turning points of the most destructive war in history, in Europe, on the Eastern Front and in the Pacific.
